SAW THIS FROM LAST MONTH, January '26:  The wife of one of the fake DTE Energy workers linked to the murder of a Rochester Hills businessman, who was also charged after dozens of her text messages were read in court, appeared for her arraignment on Wednesday.
Amanda Ileana Hernandez, 34, from Lincoln Park, pleaded not guilty to charges of conspiracy to commit first-degree home invasion, accessory after the fact and conspiracy to commit false impersonation of a utility worker.
She is the wife of Carlos Hernandez, who was sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole for murdering Hussein Murray.
Joshua Zuazo was also sentenced to life in connection with the murder.
According to the Oakland County Prosecutor’s Office, Amanda Hernandez allegedly played an active role in the planning and cover-up of the crime.
She was arraigned on Jan. 28, 2026, and was given a $100,000 cash bond. She was ordered not to contact her husband, Zuazo or the victim’s family.
If convicted, Amanda Hernandez faces up to 20 years in prison.

The badge, clipboard, and reflective vest Combined all cost less than $20. 
This is terrible. All of it. 
NEVER open your door for Anyone that you aren't expecting. 
Even if they portray themselves as law enforcement. 
(In that case, call the local P.D. and ask if they have sent an officer to rock up to your door).

Anyone that's there for a legit purpose will respect your inquiry, and anyone that isn't supposed to be there will argue and be in a huff. 

Worst case scenario: they have to wait a damn minute until you can feel safe, and assure that their credentials are legit. NO ONE that isn't there for nefarious reasons, will refuse to just Wait. 

In my early 20s, there was a knock at my apartment door. I looked thru the peephole, and saw a man with a clipboard.
After asking "who is it?" He shouted "Maintenance!"
I was so close to opening the door, when I 2nd guessed it, and said, "I didn't make a maintenance call. What do you need?"

He said, "we have to check all the smoke detectors & fire extinguishers."

I said, "Sorry, but I know the maintence man, but don't know you. So, if you need to enter my unit, please get Jose to come, and I will let him in."

He became rude and even tried the door knob. I said, "I am not letting you in. I am uncomfortable. I will only let Jose come in."

He stomped off. 
I called the office to tell them I was sorry to cause an inconvenience, but felt uncomfortable letting someone unfamiliar into my apartment.

They had No Idea what I was talking about.
I explained the interaction, and was told that it was smart to refuse to open my door because there was No such "check" happening, and Jose was, indeed, the Only maintenance man.

I will never forget that. Because I can't allow my mind to go to a place of considering who that guy was OR what could've happened if I had believed him & let him come in.
